console.changeFacts.title: Change facts
console.changeFacts.lede: What the agents suggested about a change, waiting for a library editor
console.changeFacts.explain: What you confirm here is the shared library. Every organisation reads it, and each one still decides in its own triage what to do about it.
console.changeFacts.factsToConfirm: {count, plural, one {# fact to confirm} other {# facts to confirm}}
console.changeFacts.emptyBody: Facts an agent suggests land here. Confirmed changes keep their facts and leave the list.
console.changeFacts.errorTitle: Could not load the change facts
console.changeFacts.notFoundBody: There is nothing at this address in the console.
console.changeFacts.noScope: No scope term suggested, so nothing narrows who this change reaches.
console.changeFacts.obligationsBody: These links are the library's, and every organisation reads them. An organisation deciding the same link on its own case does not change one of these.
console.changeFacts.typeHint: Only the terms on the Change type list. Missing one? Propose it on Vocabularies and the list changes for everyone once a second editor approves.
console.changeFacts.flagsHint: The whole set for this change. Clear them all and the change carries no flag.
console.changeFacts.unknownKey: That term is no longer on the list. Pick one of the terms offered here and save again.
console.changeFacts.confirmedByPerson: Confirmed by a person for the library
console.changeFacts.confirmHint: Confirming stands behind these facts, as they are shown, for every organisation. It asks for your passkey, and a fact you filed yourself is somebody else's to confirm.
console.changeFacts.ownSuggestion: You filed this yourself, so somebody else confirms it.
console.changeFacts.changedMeanwhile: This change moved while you were reading it. Check the facts again and confirm what you see.
